$comment: Media slots for the ad. Put the files in ../assets/video-src/ and run `npm run media`. Missing files render as marked placeholders. Set "ai": true for any file made with an AI model; the composition then shows the small label "AI sample" (bottom-right) wherever that slot is on screen. An optional file with the suffix -16x9 before the extension (e.g. v1-hero-film-16x9.mp4) is used by the 16:9 render instead of a centre crop.

slots.what: One real listing photo exactly as it appears on the host's listing. Landscape 3:2, at least 1500 px wide. The hero of the ad.
The film you made FROM p1, first frame matching the photo. At least 5 s. Vertical 9:16 1080x1920 preferred.
Film clip of another room or angle, at least 2.5 s, slow camera move. Vertical preferred.
Film clip, a different space again, at least 2.5 s. Vertical preferred.

scenes: 3 Cuts 10-12s, under 'No strangers in your home.'
slots.what: Film clip, ideally a calm wide shot (living room, terrace), at least 2.5 s. Vertical preferred.
A second listing photo. Its framing must match v5. Can be the same file as p1.
The film made FROM p2, first frame matching p2, at least 10 s (or it holds its last frame). Can be the same file as v1.
